Ragie is a fully-managed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) as-a-service platform. This specification covers the documented REST surface for ingesting documents, retrieving chunks, generating grounded responses, managing data connectors, extracting entities, and isolating data with partitions. All requests are authenticated with a Bearer API key.
